scripts.db:baseline: doppler run -c dev -- bun scripts/baseline.ts && doppler run -c prd -- bun scripts/baseline.ts --inject-only && doppler run -c test -- bun scripts/baseline.ts --inject-only
scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then doppler run --preserve-env="true" -- drizzle-kit migrate --config drizzle.config.ts; echo ""; else for e in "$@"; do echo ""; echo "[DB Migrate] Running for config: $e"; doppler run --preserve-env="true" -c "$e" -- drizzle-kit migrate --config drizzle.config.ts || exit 1; echo ""; done; fi' _
scripts.db:push: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then doppler run -- drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.config.ts; echo ""; else for e in "$@"; do echo ""; echo "[DB Push] Running for config: $e"; doppler run --preserve-env="true" -c "$e" -- drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.config.ts || exit 1; echo ""; done; fi' _
